content: Bitwig extension API surface (verified via DrivenByMoss + WigAI ecosystem): Two extension types — .js controller scripts (placed in Documents/Bitwig Studio/Controller Scripts/) and .bwextension Java files (placed in Documents/Bitwig Studio/Extensions/). Java is the more powerful/sturdy path; supports Bitwig 5.2.7+ for full feature set. DrivenByMoss (763 stars, 159 releases, current Bitwig 5.3+) is canonical reference: demonstrates the API exposes Transport, Tracks, Clips, Scenes, CursorTrack, CursorClip, CursorDevice, Device chains, Parameters, Automation envelopes, MIDI I/O, OSC, Beat/Tempo, Mixer, Browser. Writing to the project is supported via clip note editing (CursorClip.playNote, step entry), parameter value setting, and automation recording. WigAI (fabb, 41 stars, v0.10.1 Aug 2025) confirms Java extension can run an embedded server. taktil (joslarson, TypeScript framework) confirms JS controller API usable from TypeScript. Feasibility verdict: bw-brain's bridge component is fully buildable with official Bitwig API; ID stability needs project-local mapping since Bitwig does not expose persistent stable IDs by default.
